limitations: Asymptotic coefficient only; no exact finite-radius strong-rotundity profile is claimed.
The exponent range is real \(p>2\) and real \(L_p\) spaces with dimension at least two.
The source cited by Sprung as Xu–Zhang (1989) was not inspected in full; possible prior sharp scalar bounds remain a residual comparison risk.
